content:
Overview

Shijiazhuang is a city in Hebei with a population of 11,231,000. Capital of Hebei province, a transportation and industrial hub near Beijing, known for its pharmaceutical and textile industries. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
